meta.name: india-market-breadth
meta.description: Analyze Indian market breadth health using advance/decline data, stocks above moving averages, new highs/lows, and sector participation. Use when assessing rally quality, market participation width, or equity exposure levels for NSE/BSE.

copy.tagline: 分析印度股市宽度指标，评估市场健康度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果关注印度NSE/BSE市场的涨跌比、新高新低等宽度数据
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Indian market breadth indicators to assess market health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you track advance/decline, new highs/lows, and sector participation for NSE/BSE

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析印度 NSE/BSE 市场的广度健康度，计算 0-100 的综合评分，并给出股票仓位建议。
howto.when: 当你询问印度市场的上涨质量、参与宽度或仓位水平时触发。

say.text: 今天印度市场的广度怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会获取最新数据并评分。
Claude 会检查涨跌比、新高新低等指标。

say.text: 帮我评估一下当前印度市场的仓位建议。
say.note: Claude 会输出综合评分和推荐仓位。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the health of Indian NSE/BSE market breadth, calculates a composite score from 0 to 100, and provides equity exposure recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about rally quality, market participation width, or equity exposure levels for the Indian market.

say_en.text: How is the market breadth in India today?
say_en.note: Claude fetches latest data and scores it.
Claude checks advance/decline, new highs/lows, etc.

say_en.text: Assess the current equity exposure recommendation for India.
say_en.note: Claude outputs composite score and suggested allocation.
